marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 10 to 15 knots increasing to northwest 20 late
this evening and to northwest 25 late Friday morning. Snow changing to flurries Friday evening. Fog patches
dissipating late this evening. Visibility 1 mile or less in fog patches and as
low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures plus 3 falling to minus 2
overnight. <br/>
